title: Opens if a small amount of pressure is applied.
text:
Opens if a small amount of pressure is applied.. These Silicone Storage Bags are nice. I tested these bags in different ways. Almost everything I put in them was good except for liquids. The bags do seal but if any pressure is applied the bag will open. Not good for soup or anything with liquid.

The box comes with 10 bags. 4 16.9 oz bags, 4 33.8 oz bags, and 2 50.7 oz bags. The bags are made of silicone and are thicker than other zip bags. The box says they are freezer safe but store them where other things will not be placed on top of them. These bags are reusable and resealable.

I will not be recommending these bags to family and friends.

features: REUSABLE SILICONE BAG SET: You’ll love these silicone storage bags for packing and storing anything in your kitchen or around the house. Their stand-up design makes them easy to fill and clean, and the integrated zipper seal is simple to open and close - for little fingers too. Replace your old plastic containers with these zip-top reusable silicone containers and you’ll never be left searching for the right sized lid again.

ENDLESS USES: The silicone reusable bags are ideal for food storage, travel and home organizing. They can be used for fruit and vegetables, meat, fish, snacks, salads, hot food, or as lunch bags. You can use them to microwave pocorn or to sous vide meat, fish or vegetables.These versatile silicone ziplock bags can also be used for a variety of home organization solutions such as storing and organizing cosmetics, accessories, screws and tools or toys.

SAVE YOUR LEFTOVERS AND THE PLANET: These reusable silicone food storage bags will help you cut down on plastic wrap, disposable plastic bags and containers. Your eco-friendly choice can save hundreds of tonnes of plastic from landfills and waterways where it would harm wildlife and our entire ecosystem. They are a convenient alternative for storing leftovers, packing snacks and freezing ready-cooked food.

MICROWAVE, DISHWASHER & FREEZER SAFE: Use these reusable silicone bags in the fridge or freezer, pop in the microwave and wash in the dishwasher. They are heat-resistant up to 230°C (446°F), made from food-grade silicone which meets USA standards, and are BPA free, so you don’t need to worry about chemicals getting into your food.

GREAT HOMEWARE GIFT: Treat your family and friends to a pack of these silicone ziplock bags and they’ll thank you for months afterward. Efficient, high-quality and remarkably useful, anyone who spends time in the kitchen will use these versatile silicone storage bags time and time again. Pack contains 10 light blue zip-top silicone storage bags: 4 snack bags (0.5L), 4 sandwich bags (1L), and 2 large bags (1.5L)
